metric_semantics.trace_total_queue: composite q_by_lane proxy, not a halted vehicle count
metric_semantics.trace_mean_speed: unweighted mean of controlled incoming lane mean speeds
metric_semantics.request_accepted_false_for_stay: same phase returns false without an executor rejection
metric_semantics.tripinfo_population: inserted vehicles including unfinished; pending vehicles excluded

limitations: Pressure agreements are not traced and pressure-only has no intervention trace.
The first 256 override rows truncate the learned policies before the simulation horizon.
Zero mean speed is a sequence of lane-state samples, not measured stop-line discharge.
Retained aggregates cannot distinguish red approach starvation, green lane blockage, or upstream lane blocking.
PhasePressure has collisions; its service totals do not authorize it as a safe deployment policy.
